value: ENFORCED. Canonical standard docs/reference/CVF_AGENT_AUTORUN_WORKFLOW_CONTROL_STANDARD_2026-05-28.md and wrapper governance/compat/run_agent_autorun_workflow_gate.py require phase gates before dispatch, implementation, closure, and push. Gates are range-aware: workers must capture baseHead and closure/push must not use an empty HEAD..HEAD range. Dispatch quality now checks connector specs, false-invariant source claims, closed-artifact OPEN/checklist residue, closed-roadmap dispatch/hold residue, Fast Lane status/disposition conflicts, Allowed-scope diff drift, whole-wave closure ranges, stale line-count claims, Source Verification value/type syntax, operator-preference escalation of allowed-scope gate remediation, and runtime/source edits paired with a still-held governing work order. A boolean source field alone is not proof of field=false. Active-session state now hard-fails latest-closed-wave continuity gaps and limits parent-SHA handoff exceptions to dedicated session-sync-only commits. A failed phase gate blocks autonomous worker continuation and closed-equivalent claims; handwritten PASS claims cannot override machine gate failures. If the failure is inside Allowed scope, repair and rerun instead of asking the operator. Pre-closure also rejects unresolved worktree changes as clean closure evidence.
